text: On XX/XX/2024 I called Ability Recovery Services LLC. XXXX answered the phone very pleasant at first. I informed him what I was trying to do with a payment plan and he stated that I need to ask family or friends for some money and to call back with a reasonable payment plan and just hung up the phone. so I called back again and the phone got disconnected called back a third time and asked for a supervisor. They stated that they still had to connect me to XXXX but just ask for a supervisor. When I did that all XXXX broke out. He stated I was wasting his time and what part do I not understand. I stated this is being recorded right? and all I want to do is talk with a supervisor. He then hangs up the phone.
